notes: CRM notes: mid-market SaaS focused on product analytics for mobile apps. Primary pain: search/assistant for product insights across event+log data. Team: 2 PMs, 3 data scientists, infra lead. Wants: - embeddings at scale (nightly batch Jobs: initial 200k docs, target 2M over 6 months) - semantic search latency 95th < 75ms for top-k queries - throughput: support 300 qps for real-time search + batch ingestion pipeline for 50k docs/hour. Current stack: PostgreSQL + Kafka ingestion, Pinecone for vectors, Airflow for batch. Interested in replacing Pinecone if cost+latency favorable. They asked about Redwood's vector DB integrations and whether we support bulk async embeddings (S3 -> embeddings job). Security: Okta SSO mandatory, audit logs for admin actions, KMS integration for keys, EU data residency for certain customers. Procurement asked for dedicated pricing with monthly reserved GPU pools and overage rates. SE notes: embedding quality on par with baseline for paraphrase tasks. They saw benefits from Redwood's automatic prefix caching for short chat queries. Ops: raised Jira RWD-8421 for hosted 503s during burst; engineering provided workaround (throttled batch parallelism). Customer quote: "We need predictable cost for nightly jobs — if we spike, we can't have noisy neighbor failures."
